resources.string: Plugged in a USB camera but don\'t see it? Reopen the app.
Download the language pack to start translating
The language pack couldn\'t be downloaded. Check your connection and retry.
Drag the yellow frame over the game\'s subtitles
The app reads the subtitles on your TV through the camera. Images are processed on this device and never leave it.
Translating %1$s → %2$s needs a language pack that isn\'t on this device yet (about %3$d MB). It\'s downloaded once; after that, translation works fully offline.
I didn\'t expect to see you here.
Each language pack (about 30 MB) is downloaded once; everything then runs offline.
Off: the subtitle is shown and read aloud in its own language, with no translation.
New lines wait their turn instead of cutting the current speech. The voice can fall behind the screen.
No %1$s voice is installed. Install one under Settings › General management › Text-to-speech.
recommended: two passes, voting over 4 frames
for busy or shaky images: voting over 6 frames

Translates with Gemma 4, a language model running on this tablet: more natural phrasing, fixes leftover OCR mistakes and keeps names and tone consistent across lines. Each line appears once, complete, when the model has finished; the regular translator is only used if the AI fails. No internet, tokens or costs.
The model needs a one-time download (%1$s)
Gemma 4 (about %1$s) is downloaded once and then translates fully offline on this tablet. Wi-Fi is recommended. Until it finishes, the regular offline translation keeps working.
How should the subtitles be read?
You can switch at any time from the top bar.
Reads the picture straight from your PS5 over Wi-Fi. You keep playing on the TV with your controller.
Sharpest text, no reflections or angles
Point the tablet or a USB camera at the TV. Works with any console, TV app or screen.
Also for Netflix and other apps
Tap your PS5 to connect. It is woken from rest mode if needed.
Looking for PS5 consoles on your network… Make sure the tablet and the PS5 are on the same Wi-Fi.
The local network cannot be searched. Check that Wi-Fi is on; you can still add a PS5 by its IP address.
Pair once with the code from your PS5. After that, one tap connects.
The pairing is removed from this tablet. To use this PS5 again you need a new code from Link Device.
The PS5 is starting from rest mode. This can take up to 30 seconds.
The game keeps running on your TV; only the picture is sent to this tablet.
The PS5 did not answer. Check that it is on the same Wi-Fi and that Remote Play is enabled in Settings › System › Remote Play.
Another device is using Remote Play on this PS5. Close it there and try again.
Remote Play is not supported on this device.
This PS5 asks for the 4-digit Remote Play login PIN.
The PIN was not correct. Try again.
Drag the frame over where the game shows its subtitles
On the PS5, open Settings › System › Remote Play and turn on Enable Remote Play.
Choose Link Device. The PS5 shows an 8-digit code.
Sign in with the same PlayStation account as on the PS5 and enter the code.
Pairing failed. Check the code (it changes every few minutes), the IP address and the account.
Filled in when you sign in. It is not your password.
Only used once to find your account ID. Your password goes to Sony only.
Sign in in the browser instead. It ends on a blank \"redirect\" page: copy its full address from the address bar and paste it here.
Here is what Android recorded. Copy it and send it to the developer to get it fixed.
Game packs and these engines are for English → Turkish. Other language pairs use the regular translation.

Ready-made, reviewed Turkish translations of popular games (from the CouchSubs project). When a line is in the pack it appears instantly and reads naturally; the game is recognized by itself. Works offline.
Everything stays on the tablet. For games without a pack, an online engine translates much better; you only need your own key.
Best value: a free key from aistudio.google.com (Get API key). Subtitle text is sent to Google; on the free tier Google may use it to improve its products.
A free DeepL API key (500,000 characters a month) from deepl.com/pro-api. Subtitle text is sent to DeepL.
Your OpenAI API key from platform.openai.com (paid). Subtitle text is sent to OpenAI.
Your Anthropic API key from console.anthropic.com (paid). Subtitle text is sent to Anthropic.
Enter a key to use this engine. Until then the offline translation is used.
The key works and is saved.
The key was rejected. Check it and try again.
The key is valid but its quota is used up for now; the offline translation fills in.
The key is valid but this model is not available for it; try another model.
The service could not be reached. Check the internet connection.
Tip: if your controller disconnects while Remote Play is active, pair with a second (free) PSN account added to the PS5, so the picture is sent to a different user than the one playing.
Show the translation on the TV, over the game
The CouchSubs TV app shows the PS5 picture with the Turkish subtitle on top; the tablet sends each translation over Wi-Fi. LG webOS TVs.
Waiting for the TV app. Open CouchSubs on the TV; it finds this tablet by itself.
The TV app is not installed yet: use the button below.
Port 8787 is in use by another app (e.g. CouchSubs on this tablet). Close it and turn this on again.
Bold, colour (white or yellow) and background follow the subtitle settings below.
Update or reinstall the TV app
Installs the CouchSubs TV app on your LG TV (webOS) from this tablet, no computer needed. The tablet and the TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Turn on Developer Mode on the TV
Create a free LG developer account at webostv.developer.lge.com.
On the TV, install the Developer Mode app from the LG Content Store, open it, sign in and turn on Dev Mode Status. The TV restarts.
Open Developer Mode again and turn on Key Server. Leave the app on screen: the 6-character Passphrase appears at the bottom left.
Choose the TV below, type the Passphrase and press Install. The passphrase is needed only the first time.
No LG TV found. Is the TV on and on the same Wi-Fi? You can type its address below (TV: Settings › General › Network).
Passphrase (key saved; type only if asked)
Developer Mode stays on for a limited time. The app renews it once a day whenever it talks to the TV, so the TV app is not removed.
Getting the key from the TV…
Installed (version %1$s) and opened on the TV.
The TV app is up to date (version %1$s) and was opened on the TV.
The TV did not answer. Make sure it is on, on the same Wi-Fi, and that Dev Mode Status is on in the Developer Mode app.
Key Server is off. Turn it on in the Developer Mode app and keep the app on screen.
The passphrase is not right. Compare it with the one on the TV.
The TV refused the key. Turn on Key Server and type the passphrase again.
The TV does not have enough free space. Remove an app on the TV and try again.
The TV app package is missing from this build.
